title: dianthus superbus var. taiwanensis
intro: Dianthus superbus var. taiwanensis, commonly known as Taiwan pink, is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the carnation family (Caryophyllaceae). It is a perennial plant native to Taiwan, known for its vibrant pink flowers and medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine to promote relaxation, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality, and its therapeutic actions include sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects. The bioactive constituents of Dianthus superbus var. taiwanensis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its health benefits and medicinal properties.
